  </Hardware>
  <Reagents>
    <!--r1: C[OH2+].C[OH2+].C1CC=CCCC=C1.C1CC=CCCC=C1.[Ir].[Ir]-->
    <Reagent name="r1" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r2: [K].OC(C)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r2" role="catalyst"/>
    <!--r3: O=C1C=CC=2C=CC=C(C3=CN=C(C=C3)C=4N=CC=CC4)C2N1-->
    <Reagent name="r3" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r4: O1B(OC(C)(C)C1(C)C)B2OC(C)(C)C(O2)(C)C-->
    <Reagent name="r4" role="reagent"/>
    <!--r5: O1CCCC1-->
    <Reagent name="r5" role="solvent"/>
    <!--r6: O=C(C=1C=CC=CC1)N(CCCCCC)CCCCCC-->
    <Reagent name="r6" role="substrate"/>
  </Reagents>
  <Procedure>
    <!--Analysis context: {"pressure_control": "SEALED", "reflux": false}-->
    <!--Pressure-control context: SEALED-->
    <!--In an argon filled glove box-->
    <!--Atmosphere context (no purge operation inferred): argon; environment-->
    <!--[Ir(cod)(OMe)]2 (1.98 mg, 1.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r1" amount="0.003 mmol"/>
    <!--L1 ligand (2.1 mg, 3.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r3" amount="0.007 mmol"/>
    <!--B2pin2 (50.8 mg, 1.0 equiv.)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r4" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--KOtBu (1.0 mg, 4.5 mol%)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r2" amount="0.009 mmol"/>
    <!--dry THF (1.0 mL)-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r5" amount="6 mL"/>
    <!--The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.-->
    <Stir vessel="reactor" time="120 s"/>
    <!--To this mixture, N,N-dihexylbenzamide (57.9 mg, 0.2 mmol) was added.-->
    <Add vessel="reactor" reagent="r6" amount="0.2 mmol"/>
    <!--placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC. The reaction mixture was stirred for 12 h.-->
    <HeatChill vessel="reactor" temp="80 °C" time="43200 s" stir="true"/>
    <!--THF was removed under reduced pressure-->
    <Evaporate vessel="reactor"/>
    <!--chromatographic separation with silica gel (15% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)-->
    <RunColumn from_vessel="reactor" to_vessel="product" column="column"/>
  </Procedure>
</Synthesis>
